name: Salesforce
label: Salesforce REST v67.0 — CRM sObjects
description: Official Salesforce REST API v67.0 at https://{instance_url}/services/data/v67.0. Docs: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/. Create/update send named sObject fields (Name, LastName, Company, StageName, …). customObject.* merge INPUT fields at the JSON root. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer access_token minted outside this node. Never log access_token or VersionData/Body. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets (access_token) here. Example: {"operation":"account.get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'account.create' | 'account.upsert' | 'account.get' | 'account.list' | 'account.update' | 'account.delete' | 'account.addNote' | 'account.metadata' | 'contact.create' | 'contact.upsert' | 'contact.get' | 'contact.list' | 'contact.update' | 'contact.delete' | 'contact.addNote' | 'contact.addToCampaign' | 'lead.create' | 'lead.upsert' | 'lead.get' | 'lead.list' | 'lead.update' | 'lead.delete' | 'lead.addNote' | 'lead.addToCampaign' | 'opportunity.create' | 'opportunity.upsert' | 'opportunity.get' | 'opportunity.list' | 'opportunity.update' | 'opportunity.delete' | 'opportunity.addNote' | 'case.create' | 'case.get' | 'case.list' | 'case.update' | 'case.delete' | 'case.addComment' | 'task.create' | 'task.get' | 'task.list' | 'task.update' | 'task.delete' | 'attachment.create' | 'attachment.get' | 'attachment.list' | 'attachment.update' | 'attachment.delete' | 'customObject.create' | 'customObject.upsert' | 'customObject.get' | 'customObject.list' | 'customObject.update' | 'customObject.delete' | 'document.upload' | 'flow.list' | 'flow.invoke' | 'search.soql' | 'user.get' | 'user.list' | 'trigger.listen'. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Salesforce Id for get/update/delete and CampaignMember/CaseComment parent.

schema.label: external_id_field
schema.description: External Id field API name for upsert.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: External Id match value for upsert.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Full SOQL for *.list and search.soql. GET /query?q=. Cap 16000 chars. Reject DML. Minimize SELECT.

schema.label: sobject
schema.description: API name for customObject.* (e.g. MyThing__c).

schema.label: ParentId
schema.description: Note.ParentId or CaseComment.ParentId. Required for *.addNote and case.addComment.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: Job title (Contact/Lead) or ContentVersion/Note Title (document.upload / addNote).

schema.label: Body
schema.description: Note.Body (addNote) or Attachment.Body (base64) on attachment.create. Do not log.

schema.label: ContactId
schema.description: CampaignMember.ContactId for contact.addToCampaign.

schema.label: LeadId
schema.description: CampaignMember.LeadId for lead.addToCampaign.

schema.label: CampaignId
schema.description: CampaignMember.CampaignId. Required for contact.addToCampaign / lead.addToCampaign.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Status picklist on Lead/Case/Task/CampaignMember. Org-defined values, e.g. Open | Working | Closed.

schema.label: CommentBody
schema.description: CaseComment.CommentBody. Required for case.addComment.

schema.label: PathOnClient
schema.description: ContentVersion.PathOnClient filename for document.upload.

schema.label: FirstPublishLocationId
schema.description: Optional ContentVersion first-publish linked entity id.

schema.label: api_name
schema.description: Flow API name for flow.invoke.

schema.label: inputs
schema.description: Official invocable flow inputs body.

schema.label: ContentLocation
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ContentLocation` for operation: document.upload.

schema.label: Name
schema.description: sObject Name. Required on account.create (Account.Name) and opportunity.create. Used on Account/Opportunity/Attachment create/update/upsert. Example: Acme Ltd.

schema.label: FirstName
schema.description: First name for contact.create / lead.create (and update/upsert). Example: Ada.

schema.label: LastName
schema.description: Last name. Required by Salesforce on contact.create and lead.create. Example: Lovelace.

schema.label: Email
schema.description: Email on Contact/Lead create/update/upsert. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: Phone
schema.description: Phone on Account/Contact/Lead create/update/upsert.

schema.label: MobilePhone
schema.description: Mobile on Contact/Lead create/update/upsert.

schema.label: Company
schema.description: Company. Required on lead.create. Example: Analytical Engines.

schema.label: AccountId
schema.description: Related Account Id on Contact/Opportunity/Case create/update.

schema.label: Description
schema.description: Description on Account/Lead/Opportunity/Case/Task create/update.

schema.label: Type
schema.description: Type picklist on Account/Opportunity/Case. Org-defined, e.g. Customer | Prospect.

schema.label: Industry
schema.description: Industry picklist on Account/Lead.

schema.label: Website
schema.description: Website URL on Account/Lead. Example: https://example.com.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: Subject on Case/Task create/update. Example: Reset password.

schema.label: Origin
schema.description: Case Origin picklist on case.create/update, e.g. Phone | Email | Web.

schema.label: Priority
schema.description: Priority on Case/Task, e.g. High | Medium | Low.

schema.label: Amount
schema.description: Opportunity Amount on opportunity.create/update/upsert. Example: 25000.

schema.label: StageName
schema.description: Opportunity StageName. Required on opportunity.create. Org-defined, e.g. Prospecting.

schema.label: CloseDate
schema.description: Opportunity CloseDate YYYY-MM-DD. Required on opportunity.create. Example: 2026-12-31.

schema.label: BillingStreet
schema.description: Account BillingStreet on account.create/update/upsert.

schema.label: BillingCity
schema.description: Account BillingCity on account.create/update/upsert. Example: London.

schema.label: BillingState
schema.description: Account BillingState on account.create/update/upsert.

schema.label: BillingPostalCode
schema.description: Account BillingPostalCode on account.create/update/upsert.

schema.label: BillingCountry
schema.description: Account BillingCountry on account.create/update/upsert. Example: United Kingdom.

schema.label: LeadSource
schema.description: LeadSource picklist on Lead/Opportunity.

schema.label: AnnualRevenue
schema.description: Account/Lead AnnualRevenue.

schema.label: NumberOfEmployees
schema.description: Account/Lead NumberOfEmployees.

schema.label: Probability
schema.description: Opportunity Probability 0–100.

schema.label: ActivityDate
schema.description: Task ActivityDate YYYY-MM-DD on task.create/update.

schema.label: WhoId
schema.description: Task WhoId (Contact or Lead Id) on task.create/update.

schema.label: WhatId
schema.description: Task WhatId (Account/Opportunity/Case Id) on task.create/update.

schema.label: ContentType
schema.description: Attachment ContentType on attachment.create, e.g. application/pdf.

schema.label: VersionData
schema.description: ContentVersion VersionData (base64) for document.upload. Required with PathOnClient. Do not log.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: customObject.create / update / upsert: sObject field API names merged at the JSON root (bodyMap $). Example: {"Name":"Widget","My_Field__c":"x"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. PII may be present — do not log bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: account.create | account.upsert | account.get | account.list | account.update | account.delete | account.addNote | account.metadata | contact.create | contact.upsert | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | contact.addNote | contact.addToCampaign | lead.create | lead.upsert | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.delete | lead.addNote | lead.addToCampaign | opportunity.create | opportunity.upsert | opportunity.get | opportunity.list | opportunity.update | opportunity.delete | opportunity.addNote | case.create | case.get | case.list | case.update | case.delete | case.addComment | task.create | task.get | task.list | task.update | task.delete | attachment.create | attachment.get | attachment.list | attachment.update | attachment.delete | customObject.create | customObject.upsert | customObject.get | customObject.list | customObject.update | customObject.delete | document.upload | flow.list | flow.invoke | search.soql | user.get | user.list | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Salesforce access_token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Obtain via External Client App OAuth refresh or JWT bearer outside this node. Never log or place on INPUT. My Domain base is in api_spec.json (replace yourinstance).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 uses api_spec default. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Instance URL host
configurationParameters.description: My Domain host only (no scheme), from the token response instance_url host. Example: mycompany.my.salesforce.com. Substituted into https://{instance_url}/services/data/v67.0.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
